content: The Cyclic Processing of the ComData If a ComData (system signal or system signal group) is mapped to a VariableDataPrototype (via Rte- ComDataVariableDataPrototypeInstanceRef ), RTE shall perform the com- plete read process within the cyclic function Rte_ComDataMainFunction of these ComData including: 404 of 1609 Document ID 84: AUTOSAR_CP_SWS_RTE Specification of RTE Software AUTOSAR CP R25-11 • Check if a new data is received. • Retrieve the data received from COM module for these ComData (Signal/Signal- Group). The data can be received by two ways: – Using the stored data by Rte if the ComData is received data by Com Call- backs. – Using Com Receive APIs (e.g. Com_ReceiveSignalGroup ). • Execute the inverse data transformation, if applicable.
